principles_extracted: Bind claims to immutable digest-identified subjects rather than names alone.
Separate untrusted external parameters/caller claims from trusted control-plane-generated execution metadata.
Represent executor/builder identity and invocation identity explicitly; provenance quality depends on the trust boundary of that identity.
Keep whole-trace causal identity distinct from per-operation parent/span identity; caller trace flags are not authority.
For J-Space/GWT causality, require controlled interventions and measured target effects rather than recurrence, textual coherence or self-report.
Activation steering can produce off-target behavioral changes; steering-readiness evaluation must include negative/off-target and broad-behavior regression checks, not only target-direction gain.
